results.title: The Odyssemen
results.overview: After undergoing the split of Meiosis, meiosisters Orchis and Semes awaken as sperm in the ethereal land of Test, where the annual Testy Festy welcomes them to what seems like heaven. Things take a turn when Seed, a strange sperm donning a condom mask, claims that their paradise is a lie and calls for the start of the Great Jac, a taboo event prophesied to lead either to the Promised Unknown or to death. A sperm civil war breaks out as rebels and loyalists fight over whether their world is truly heaven or merely the prelude to something far greater...

results.title: Nest
results.overview: Shamila lives in Iran with her two siblings. They are Afghan immigrants whose parents were tragically killed in a terrorist attack in Kabul. After two years of residing in Iran, they attempt to enroll their younger brother, Samir, in school, but the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran prevent them from doing so.

results.title: On the Street Where You Live
results.original_title: On the Street Where You Live
results.overview: A shy teenage girl, inspired after reading Romeo and Juliet, stakes out her crush's neighborhood, hoping to feel closer to him. A modern, Shakespearean inspired story that celebrates the exploration of girlhood, confidence, and self-worth.

results.title: The Republic
results.overview: In 1999, in his hometown of Bristol, Banksy painted one of his earliest pieces, ‘The Mild, Mild West’ on a wall in Stokes Croft.  "The Republic " documents the struggles of Stokes Croft since, portraying a diverse community that dares to defy the cold winds of corporate power and globalisation. But their greatest challenge looms as developers target this quarter and ready their wrecking balls.  Filmed over six years, with access to twenty years of personal archives, this compelling story of our times recounts the fight by locals to retain some control over their destiny in an increasingly monocultural world.

results.title: Suicide Tuesday
results.overview: Tove, a troubled young woman, is contemplating suicide when she meets Jesse, a carefree vagabond. She agrees to remain in his company on one condition: he must help her find heroin.

results.title: A Proper Christmas
results.overview: When her beloved British grandmother Iris arrives just in time for Christmas, Nora, a warm-hearted small-town schoolteacher and devoted single mom, finds her carefully ordered life beginning to shift in ways she never anticipated. Settling into their cozy coastal Southern town, Iris brings with her six generations of family Christmas ornaments, an arsenal of proper British recipes, and an unmistakable talent for gentle meddling.

results.title: A Month In Minnesota
results.overview: When a federal ICE invasion brought chaos and death to their streets and neighborhoods, an unlikely network of grassroots organizers, local business owners, students, and caregivers stepped forward to act. From a nurse midwife visiting pregnant women who were afraid to leave their homes, to a songleader helping people raise their voices in unified protest, the film showcases a diverse coalition who stood up for their community.

results.title: OceanGate Disaster: Minute by Minute
results.overview: A minute by minute reconstruction of the events surrounding the 2023 Titan submersible tragedy.

results.title: Brush
results.overview: A father and son tries to mend their relationship while working on a plan to fake the old man's death.

results.title: One Team in Tallinn: 30 Years On
results.original_title: One Team in Tallinn: 30 Years On
results.overview: In October 1996, it was full steam ahead for the Tartan Army on the way to the World Cup in France. However, when Scotland lined up to face Estonia in Tallinn, there was just one thing missing - the opposition.

results.title: Mordkommission Calw - Die Hesse-Verschwörung
results.overview: The unsuccessful and financially troubled writer Umberto Designori discovers a historical document in the Ticino village of Montagnola. Suspecting that it was authored by the famous writer Hermann Hesse, who spent the final years of his life in Montagnola, he sets off for Calw. However, the town archivist and Hesse expert, Dr. Giebenrath, reveals to him that the document is a forgery. The following night, Designori falls to his death. The supposed Hesse letter has disappeared. Detectives Lola Kraft and Jasmin Stein of the "Mordkommission Calw" begin their investigation.

results.title: Once a Princess, Always a Princess
results.original_title: Once a Princess, Always a Princess
results.overview: Follows two young girls living in neighboring apartment buildings whose shared love of Disney Princess stories sparks a friendship that transforms everyday moments into magical adventures, later passing these traditions to their daughters.

results.title: The Neighborhood: A Farewell Special
results.overview: Entertainment Tonight celebrates the sitcom's eight-season run with cast interviews, exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, and an emotional look at the final table read, last tapings, wrap party, and series finale preview.

results.title: Your Attention Please
results.overview: A quiet revolution is underway: As the real-world consequences of social media come into focus, a new generation of parents and teens step forward to challenge the systems shaping their lives and fight for a different future.

results.title: Motherhood
results.overview: When a college girl returns home suddenly, she finds her mother with her former tutor, igniting a tense confrontation that exposes the unspoken truths lingering in their quiet home.

results.title: Panchhi 2
results.overview: After losing love, Panchi finds love through a voice on the same phone number, until truth, crime, and blood ties pull him into a dark spiral of fate.

results.title: Gavage
results.overview: A duck farmer is facing serious financial problems. His farm is on the verge of bankruptcy. To save the farm, he must produce a very unusual and eerie version of “foie gras“ at the behest of his bosses.

results.title: Ends Meat
results.overview: A woman is confronted with the realization that she's misunderstood the meaning of a common phrase.
